sourceText: User asked to implement Story 1 and Story 2 first so playbook can consume experience: Story 1 proves each DONE story experience can become a candidate; Story 2 proves candidate exposure plus structured outcome can trigger evidence-based activation and runtime consumption, without default-off fake closure or human subjective promotion.
normalizedOutcome: Story 2 is complete when an explicit candidate exposure with structured helped outcomes can be activated by lattice playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json and then verified as active runtime guidance, while DONE success alone still cannot count as helped evidence.
acceptanceClaim: A real CLI smoke shows seed-to-candidate, explicit outcome recording, playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply activatedCount=1, runtime consumption verification consumedByAll=true, idempotent second apply, and fail-closed behavior before explicit outcomes or for DONE-settlement/no-exposure rows.
